1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 c5 4.e3 Nf6 5.Nf3.strategy: Completes the development of the kingside knight and guards d4 a second time, so a capture on d4 can be met by recapturing with the pawn or the knight. The structure is symmetrical, and the tension can later be released into hanging pawns or an isolated pawn; the game is quiet and positional.
